ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions on both lobes; a central black wedge extending from the peduncle base to the median notch; multiple small, isolated black focal spots (approximately 5-8 pixels in diameter) scattered across the white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 95 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:1.5 within its local bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 10 pixels along the entire span of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of high-contrast, dark focal spots on the mid-white section of the right lobe and upper-left section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, textured brown/white barnacle clusters (Coronula diadema) attached to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown bio-staining/diatom film visible on the proximal white surfaces adjacent to the central black pigmentation.
